win32

win32 Components
  • Box A box lays its children out as its mode says.
  • Button A push button.
  • Canvas The window a `draw.canvas` is.
  • CheckBox A check box Win32 checks itself as it is pressed, which `@click` reports once it has.
  • DatePicker A date picker, whose check box unchecked is no date.
  • Divider An etched line across a box, or down it where it is vertical.
  • Edit A single-line EDIT control.
  • Flow A flow is a runtime window that wraps and draws the words of the spans it holds, as a GTK label does Pango's: the runtime resolves the cascade, each span's look over the one around it, starting from the flow's own.
  • Image An image: a node holding the picture it shows, which fills it, painted as `fit` says and measured at the picture's size.
  • ImageDrawing A source showing what its shapes draw, `width` by `height` pixels: a picture whose bitmap the shapes paint, as the handler of its `@paint`, and a write to what they read paints again, as a canvas is.
  • Link A text drawn as a link, which opens `href` as the user clicks it and reports the click.
  • MenuEntry An entry of the menu bar of the window it is in, wherever in the window it is, taking no room in its box; one holding entries is their submenu.
  • Modal A node taking no room in its box, whose children are shown in a window of their own over the window it is in while it is `open`, that window disabled meanwhile.
  • Paint The primitive every shape below paints through: its handler is spliced into the drawing, written against the canvas's context.
  • Picture A picture, showing what `url` names: a file the program carries, one fetched for an http or https URL, or a file on disk.
  • Progress A progress bar, filled to `fraction` of it, or indeterminate where that is negative.
  • Radio A radio button, which unchecks the others in its box as the user checks it; `@click` reports it once it has.
  • Scroll A box scrolling what it holds along its axes, which reports its end coming within half a page of showing as it arrives there.
  • Select A drop-down list.
  • Spacer Room a box shares out by its flex and draws nothing in.
  • Span
  • TabPage One page of a tab control, its tab titled `title`.
  • Table A list view of rows and columns.
  • Tabs A tab control, which shows a tab for each page it holds and the page of the one `selected`.
  • Text A STATIC control, its text on one line per line it holds, which reports a click on it.
  • TextArea A multi-line EDIT control, which scrolls down.
  • Tree A tree view.
  • Window A toplevel: the window a `ui.window` is.
  • drawSource The primitive a `canvasImage` paints its source through.
  • platform The `win32` node of a build directive: `output { c { win32() } }`.
    • Types
  • DrawEvent What a `@draw` handler is handed: the context, and the coordinate space the shapes were placed in.
  • Gfx A canvas is a window of the runtime's that GDI+ paints, through a context whose calls are cairo's, as gtk4's are: a path built, then filled or stroked in the color, line and font last set, which save and restore keep (sngl_win32_gfx).
  • Look What a node's style asks of the runtime (sngl_win32_look): its share of a box's spare room, the gap between a box's children, the room inside its edges, its least size, its colors as 0xRRGGBB or -1 for the system's, and its font size, 0 for the system's, and 1 where its style's display hides it, which takes it out of its box's layout.
  • SourceEvent What a `drawSource` paints an image a URL names with.
  • ui
    • Enums
  • BoxMode How a box lays its children out.
    • Functions
  • alignOf Where a line box places its children across it: the runtime's A_STRETCH, A_START, A_CENTER or A_END.
  • arcTo The corner `sngl:ui/draw` solves, drawn as a line in and an arc, which leaves the path at the point it answers.
  • baseOf A style's weight, slant and family as a span's, the two enums in the same order with `inherit` where a style is `unset`.
  • boundDates Bounds the dates a picker offers; "" is no bound.
  • boxLookOf A box's Look, whose gap is otherwise where its style sets none.
  • chooseMenu Chooses the entry labeled `label` in the menu bar of the window `n` is in, as the user does: a test's way to a menu.
  • chooseNode Selects the node labeled `label`, unreported.
  • chosenNode The label of the node a tree has selected, or "".
  • clickColumn
  • editText An edit's text, a multi-line one's included, read off it.
  • fillTable Gives a table its columns, `columns` one a line, and its rows, `rows` one a line of cells separated by tabs, reporting nothing.
  • fillTree Gives a tree its nodes, `lines` one a line, each indented a tab a level, expanding those whose places in that order `expanded` lists, comma separated.
  • gridColumns
  • gridMode
  • imageFailure Why an image's picture failed, or "".
  • inset The runtime lays nothing outside the room a box gives a child, so a negative length, which CSS allows, is none, and so is an unset one.
  • isChecked Whether a check box is checked, read off it.
  • isOpen Whether a modal's window is shown.
  • isPicked
  • lookOf A block rather than an expression, so the optimizer calls it instead of splicing a computed Style into each of the fields that read it.
  • menuItems How many items the menu bar of the window `n` is in holds.
  • offerChoices Offers a drop-down the labels `labels` joins with newlines and selects `chosen` where one of them is it, reporting neither.
  • paint Fill then stroke the current path, keeping it between the two where both apply, as gtk4's paint does.
  • pickDate
  • pickNode
  • pickRow A test's choice, as the user's, in the first table, tree or date picker of the window `n` is in: a row selected, a column header clicked, a node selected by its label, a date picked ("YYYY-MM-DD", or "" for none).
  • pickTab Chooses the tab at `index` as the user's click on it does, which reports it.
  • px A length in pixels at 96 DPI, an em being 16 of them, as html's default is.
  • quit Ends the message loop, and with it the program: a window-less program's, such as one an `@run` handler started without calling run, way out.
  • rgb A color as 0xRRGGBB, or -1 for none, which is what an unset or a transparent one is.
  • selectLabel Selects the choice labeled `label` as the user's pick does, which reports it.
  • selectRow Selects a table's row `row`, or none where it is negative, unreported.
  • selectedLabel The label of the choice a drop-down has selected, or "".
  • selectedRow The row a table has selected, or -1.
  • setEditText Writes an edit's text where it differs, reporting no change: see ui.input.
  • setTable Whether a table's rows can be selected, and its rows sorted by a column whose header is clicked.
  • showDate Shows the date `iso`, "YYYY-MM-DD", or none where it is "", unreported.
  • shownDate The date a picker shows, "YYYY-MM-DD", or "" for none.
  • side One side of a padding: the first of its own field, its axis's and the whole box's that is set, as CSS reads them.
  • sortedColumn The header of the column the user last clicked.
  • source
    • Constants
  • salMacros The source annotations MinGW's sal.h, specstrings.h and driverspecs.h define as macros, which windows.h includes: a local lowering names `__out` was read by the preprocessor as one.
  • unstyled What a Style may say that this platform does not answer yet: - margin and its sides: the runtime's box gives each child the room it measures and no more; a padding on the box is the room around them.
